newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes softer on weak U.S. dollar.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes softer on weak U.S. dollar.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed slightly weaker at C$1.3538 (US$0.7387) on Tuesday from Monday's close at C$1.3530 (US$0.7391).
* Dealers said a softer U.S. dollar gutted European interest to buy Canadian dollars and made for a quiet day.
* The currency could test C$1.3500 on Wednesday.
The market fears the Bank of Canada may move to cut interest rates once the unit reaches that level, dealers said.

Much depends on what Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin says on Wednesday when he gives an update on the budget deficit. Martin is expected to deliver a better-than-forecast number for the 1995/96 budget deficit.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar eased to 1.1298 marks from Monday's close of 1.1306 marks but rose to 82.43 yen from 82.09 yen.
